gloss: memorial anniversary; anniversary of a death

definitions.gloss: memorial anniversary; anniversary of a person's death observed with a Buddhist ceremony
definitions.explanation: Specific anniversaries of a death on which memorial services are held. In Japanese Buddhism, these occur at fixed intervals and are important family and religious occasions.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}の{三回忌|さんかいき}の{年忌|ねんき}{法要|ほうよう}。
examples.english: The third-year memorial service for my grandfather.

examples.japanese: {年忌|ねんき}には{親族|しんぞく}が{集|あつ}まってお{経|きょう}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: At memorial anniversaries, relatives gather and have sutras recited.

examples.japanese: {来年|らいねん}は{母|はは}の{七回忌|ななかいき}なので、{年忌|ねんき}{法要|ほうよう}の{準備|じゅんび}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Since next year is my mother's seventh-year memorial, I started preparing for the memorial service.

notes:
Composed of {年|ねん} (year) + {忌|き} (mourning, memorial). Refers to the Buddhist tradition of holding memorial services at specific intervals after death.

MEMORIAL YEAR SCHEDULE:
The major {年忌|ねんき} in Japanese Buddhism are:
- {一周忌|いっしゅうき}: 1st anniversary
- {三回忌|さんかいき}: 3rd year (actually 2 years after death — counts the year of death as year 1)
- {七回忌|ななかいき}: 7th year
- {十三回忌|じゅうさんかいき}: 13th year
- {三十三回忌|さんじゅうさんかいき}: 33rd year (often the final service)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年忌|ねんき}{法要|ほうよう}: memorial service
- {年忌|ねんき}を{営|いとな}む: to hold a memorial service
- {年忌|ねんき}に{当|あ}たる: to fall on a memorial year

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {法事|ほうじ}: Buddhist memorial service — the event itself, while {年忌|ねんき} refers to the anniversary
- {命日|めいにち}: anniversary of death — the specific date, observed annually; {年忌|ねんき} refers to the special milestone anniversaries
- {法要|ほうよう}: Buddhist ceremony — the formal religious service held at a {年忌|ねんき}
